description: Change a price-book material: its name, description, price, cost or whether it is taxable. Fields you omit are left alone. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Prices in DOLLARS - this server converts to Housecall Pro's integer cents for you. Nothing is sent to any customer. Estimates and invoices already written keep the figures they were written with; this changes what the price book offers next time.

cost_dollars.description: What it costs you, in dollars

price_dollars.description: What you sell it for, in dollars

name: hcp_update_pricebook_material
